meta.name: c-level-skills
meta.description: Index and router for the C-level advisory bundle: 33 skills covering 14 C-suite roles, orchestration, cross-cutting capabilities, and culture. Use when exploring what the c-level-advisor bundle contains, deciding which advisor skill fits a question, or finding the entry points (cs-onboard interview, chief-of-staff routing, board-meeting protocol).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浏览和路由高管顾问技能包
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从一套高管顾问技能中快速找到合适的入口。
copy.tagline_en: Browse and route the C-level advisory skill bundle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find the right entry point among a set of C-level advisory skills.

howto.what: 这个技能是C-Level顾问包的索引与路由器：它不直接提供建议，而是列出包内的33个技能、14个高管角色及入口（如创始人访谈、路由矩阵、董事会议事），并指引你使用对应的顾问技能。
howto.when: 当你询问C-Level顾问包包含哪些内容、想判断某个问题该用哪个顾问技能，或需要找到相应入口（如创始人访谈、董事会审议）时触发。

say.text: 这个C-Level顾问包里有哪33个技能？
公司烧钱太快，该问哪个顾问？
say.note: Claude会路由到首席财务官等角色。

howto.what_en: This skill is the index and router for the C-Level advisory bundle. It does not give advice itself; it lists the 33 skills, 14 C-suite roles, and entry points (founder interview, routing, board meeting) and points you to the right advisor skill.
howto.when_en: Use when exploring what the c-level-advisor bundle contains, deciding which advisor skill fits a question, or finding the entry points (onboarding, chief-of-staff routing, board-meeting protocol).

say_en.text: What skills are in the C-Level advisory bundle?
say_en.note: Claude will list the bundle contents.

say_en.text: We're burning cash too fast; which advisor should I ask?
say_en.note: Claude routes to the CFO advisor, etc.
